Ticket:
Pharmacy substitution messaging workflow freezes

We received an out-of-stock alert for a medication we prescribed this morning. When trying to switch the prescription to an alternative agent using the substitution workflow, the system froze on the pharmacy messaging screen. We tried canceling out and reopening the chart twice, but it keeps locking up at the same step. Please advise how to complete this switch.
